style: Tropical castaway gouache illustration for a co-operative island survival card game, turquoise, sand, jungle green and driftwood colours, soft rim light, matte paper texture, slightly wobbly dark ink outline, simple readable silhouette that works small, centred, plenty of margin, no text
notes: Pose / expression set. One character = one reused description + the reference painting (meta.ref) + the same seed, same camera, same scale, centred, feet on one baseline. Background is flat chroma colour (meta.bg) so games-src/scripts/cutout.py can key it: save each as <name>.png in one folder per character, then python3 games-src/scripts/cutout.py <folder>/<char>-*.png --out <target folder> --size 512 --align <meta.align>  (writes transparent webp + contact-sheet.png). Check the contact sheet: all poses the same height, same feet line. Style block: use the one in "style" but ignore any background wording in it.
